description: This file implements a Text-to-Speech (TTS) service integration for Speechmatics within a larger project. It defines the `SpeechmaticsTTSService` class, which provides methods to synthesize speech from text by interacting with Speechmatics' HTTP API, handling retries, streaming audio chunks, and producing distinct frames for different stages of TTS processing.

classes.name: SpeechmaticsTTSService
classes.description: Implements a TTS service interface for Speechmatics, enabling text-to-speech synthesis via REST API, with retry logic, streaming response handling, and metrics support.

classes.name: InputParams
classes.description: Nested data model class defining optional configuration parameters for the Speechmatics TTS service, currently supporting max_retries.

methods.description: Asynchronous generator that sends text to Speechmatics API to produce streamed audio frames, handling retries and errors, and emitting frame signals for different processing stages.
